newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung Fine sets four-to-10 rights.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Fine sets four-to-10 rights.

text.p: South Korea's Samsung Fine Chemical Ltd said on Friday it would offer a four-to-10 rights issue in June to generate investment funds for facilities.
The issue will increase the company's paid-in capital to 33.75 billion won from 22.5 billion at present.
A Samsung Fine statement said the company plans to issue 2.25 million common shares, of which 20 percent would be first offered to its employees.
The rest will be allocated to the company's shareholders registered as of May 6 for rights.
The issue price will be set at a 20 percent discount to the base price, which will be decided later.
Shareholders' subscription is scheduled for June 4 and 5, with payment due by June 10.
